origin: ts.mbt — found while attributing typebox's -2.98%: predicate-inline copies the argument once per parameter reference
what: `isOne(bump())` became `bump() === 1 && bump() !== 2 && bump() > 0` — the argument evaluated three times, `effects` 3 instead of 1. The corpus checks behaviour, so it catches the duplication directly. Case 3 is the control: an identifier argument IS safe to duplicate and must still produce the same answer, so the fix cannot be 'stop inlining'.
